trap.label: passiva em anúncio
trap.wrong: This bag makes from recycled plastic. It developed by engineers. Only 500 units is available.
trap.right: This bag is made from recycled plastic. It was developed by engineers. Only 500 units are available.
trap.why: Em português “é feita de plástico” e “foi desenvolvida” usam ser; o brasileiro cai no verbo ativo sem be, e o sujeito plural concorda mal. Em inglês: be + pp.

fix.right: The desk is made of oak.

fix.wrong: The app was develop in Brazil.
fix.right: The app was developed in Brazil.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “Engineers developed the lamp.”
